A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt="A" src="S"/>\n</div>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
